videos.headline: Axar to Taijul Islam, out Bowled!! India win by 188 runs. Timber! Quick in-turner from a length, Taijul Islam hangs back and is late to bring his bat down, gets beaten on the inside edge and the ball crashes into the sticks. Four wickets in the innings for Axar! Taijul Islam b Axar 4(15)

Kuldeep Yadav to Ebadot Hossain, out Caught by Shreyas Iyer!! Nine down! Sharp catch at forward short leg. Leg-break, Ebadot Hossain looks to work it away into the on-side off the back foot. Off the face of the bat but he couldn't get it past the short leg fielder. Good reflexes from Shreyas Iyer to gobble it with both hands. Ebadot Hossain c Shreyas Iyer b Kuldeep Yadav 0(5)

Kuldeep Yadav to Shakib, out Bowled!! And, Shakib's fun ends! With all the fielders in, Shakib shapes up to play an aerial stroke. Moves leg-side and gets down on one leg to slog-sweep. It was a length ball from Kuldeep Yadav and the ball spun away to beat the bat and crash into the middle-stump. End of an entertaining knock from Shakib. Shakib b Kuldeep Yadav 84(108) [4s-6 6s-6]

Siraj to Mehidy Hasan Miraz, out Caught by Umesh Yadav!! In the air and taken! It's a tempter from Siraj. Length ball wide of off, Mehidy Hasan Miraz goes for the cover drive by playing away from his body. He got a boundary against the same bowler earlier but this time he doesn't middle it. Off the outer part of the bat and it's a dolly for Umesh at backward point. Mehidy Hasan Miraz c Umesh Yadav b Siraj 13(48) [4s-3]

Axar to Mushfiqur, out Bowled!! Bowled him! A lovely delivery from Axar to nip out Mushfiqur. He's been spot-on with the second new ball. Mushfiqur stays back and plays for the angle expecting this length ball to come in. The ball, however, spins and beats the outside edge to crash into the off-stump. Very similar to Yasir Ali's wicket. Second wicket for Axar and he has his arms aloft. Bangladesh have now lost half their side. Mushfiqur b Axar 23(50) [4s-2]

Ashwin to Zakir Hasan, out Caught by Kohli!! Oh bat-pad, taken at slip. Zakir Hasan walks. He is gutted. Hundred and out as Ashwin gets his first wicket of the game. He changed ends and bowled this slider, Zakir was looking to defend, played for turn, got the inside edge it lobbed off the pad. Alert Virat dived forward at slip to end a fantastic innings from Zakir. Walks off raising the bat to a great ovation. Zakir Hasan c Kohli b Ashwin 100(224) [4s-12 6s-1]

Kuldeep Yadav to Litton Das, out Caught by Umesh Yadav!! Das' misery is over, Kuldeep finally gets his man! You could see this coming from a long way off. Das was all at sea against the wrist spinner and finally perishes in an attempt to hit his way out of trouble. Not the wisest option in a Test match, more so when you're looking to bat time. But that's what nervousness does to you. Das decides to go with the turn against the leg-break but it's half-hearted chip stroke that's straight to long-on. Even if we try to justify the intent, there is simply no justification of the shot selection. Why hit the baill in the air to an area where there is a boundary-rider? Litton Das c Umesh Yadav b Kuldeep Yadav 19(59) [4s-2]

Axar to Yasir Ali, out Bowled!! Timber! Yasir Ali stands in disbelief. Bangladesh lose two quick wickets. Angled in from round the wicket, lands around off and middle, Yasir Ali is forward to block but he ends up playing down the wrong line. The ball spins away to beat the outside edge and crash into the off-stump. Yasir Ali b Axar 5(12) [4s-1]

Axar to Yasir Ali, out Bowled!! Timber! Yasir Ali stands in disbelief. Bangladesh lose two quick wickets. Angled in from round the wicket, lands around off and middle, Yasir Ali is forward to block but he ends up playing down the wrong line. The ball spins away to beat the outside edge and crash into the off-stump. Yasir Ali b Axar 5(12) [4s-1]

Umesh Yadav to Shanto, out Caught by Pant!! Edged ... and ... Kohli drops ... but ... Pant catches! Loose shot from Shanto and India finally have the breakthrough. Short of a length from round the wicket around the fifth-sixth stump zone. That should have been left alone, but the left-hander sticks his bat out to have a feel for it. Thick outside edge and goes to the right of first slip. Regulation catch but Kohli makes a mes of it. Pant, however, had the presence of mind to dive across to his left and snaffle it. Shanto is distraught as he takes the long walk back. Shanto c Pant b Umesh Yadav 67(156) [4s-7]

Khaled Ahmed to Rahul, out Caught by Taijul Islam!! Short ball ploy works in just four deliveries! Rahul never looked comfortable against it due to the variable bounce off this slow pitch. This is the proper bouncer that bounces and hurries him on the pull shot, gets a top-edge and Taijul does the rest at fine leg. Another start for KL but he fails to kick on. Some respite for Bangladesh. Rahul c Taijul Islam b Khaled Ahmed 23(62) [4s-3]

Kuldeep Yadav to Ebadot Hossain, out Caught by Pant!! That's the fifer for Kuldeep Yadav - third in Tests. Ebadot Hossain stands there in disbelief because he's batted this long with a good defence but is now caught down leg-side. Was a sharp turner that finished around leg stump, Ebadot looks to defend, gets an inside edge and how alert was Pant to move to the leg-side and grab that cleanly. Ebadot Hossain c Pant b Kuldeep Yadav 17(37) [4s-2 6s-1]

Kuldeep Yadav to Mushfiqur, out Lbw!! Appeal for lbw, up goes the dreaded finger and Mushfiqur reviews it. Lovely legbreak from Kuldeep and Mushfiqur is drawn forward into his defence. The fullish ball spins in, beats the inside edge and thuds into his front pad adjacent to the sticks. Clearly no bat. Over to ball-tracking and it's hitting leg! Three reds, Bangladesh lose Mushfiqur as well as a review. Wicket number three for Kuldeep Yadav and Bangladesh lose their seventh wicket. Mushfiqur lbw b Kuldeep Yadav 28(58) [4s-3]

Kuldeep Yadav to Shakib, out Caught by Kohli!! Brain fade from Shakib and Kuldeep strikes second ball! Stepped out way too early and the length was smartly pulled back a fraction by the wrist spinner. Landed the leg break on a perfect length and Shakib didn't help himself by trying to play across the line. Thick outside edge and it is safely at slip. The move to introduce Kuldeep ahead of Axar has worked like magic for KL. Shakib c Kohli b Kuldeep Yadav 3(25)

Siraj to Zakir Hasan, out Caught by Pant!! Edged and gone! Third wicket for Siraj. Rare loose poke from Zakir Hasan and the debutant has to walk back. That should have been left alone. Short of a good length delivery, angled in from round the wicket and it nibbles away ever so lightly. Zakir chases it to have a feel for it and gets a faint outside edge. Easy grab for Pant. The ploy to change to round the wicket works almost straightaway. Zakir Hasan c Pant b Siraj 20(45) [4s-3]

Siraj to Litton Das, out Bowled!! Siraj has his man! Lapse in concentation? 141kph, length ball that nips in with the angle and keeps a shade low. Litton Das, staying in his crease, doesn't bring his bat down in time. Hits the cue-end of the bat and then deflects onto the sticks. Siraj celebrates with his finger on the lips. Litton Das, who was looking in good touch, departs! Litton Das b Siraj 24(30) [4s-5]

Umesh Yadav to Yasir Ali, out Bowled!! The leg stump has gone cartwheeling! Umesh's turn to strike and he's done Ali in for pace here. Plugged away on that good length spot just outside off, skiddy delivery and Ali tried to play this on the off-side through the back foot. Played well away from the body and could only manage an inside edge onto the stumps. It's not a dismissal he'd want to look back on. A very amateurish dismissal for a top-order batter against fast bowling. Bangladesh in early trouble. Yasir Ali b Umesh Yadav 4(17)

Siraj to Shanto, out Caught by Pant!! Siraj strikes off the very first ball! The perfect start for India and they are understandably buzzing. Probing line straightaway from Siraj, no loosener stuff at all as he angles this across from an off stump line, shaping further across Shanto whose feet go nowhere on the poke. Thick outside edge and Pant takes a diving catch to his left. We saw both the new balls offer a little bit of help yesterday and if this delivery is any indication, Bangladesh firstly have an acid test to survive before the spinners come on. Shanto c Pant b Siraj 0(1)

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Ashwin, out Stumped!! Oh Ashwin has run down the pitch way too early. He plays for turn but Mehidy Hasan Miraz got this to go straight past the outside edge. Easy stumping. End of a fine innings from Ashwin. How crucial was that diving save previous ball? Ashwin may not have been on strike this ball if there was a second or four. The keeper waited ages to remove the bails. Ashwin st Nurul Hasan b Mehidy Hasan Miraz 58(113) [4s-2 6s-2]

Ebadot Hossain to Shreyas Iyer, out Bowled!! The off stump has been ripped out! The hard-working Ebadot finally has a wicket to his name and he looks upwards with a sigh of relief. Should have gotten more wickets but there were dropped catches and also a bowled dismissal where the bail didn't come off, against Iyer itself. Not this time. A peach of a delivery. Angling in on a length around off, and then straightening ever so slightly to beat the batter on the outside edge. Iyer's footwork was static, perhaps due to the short ball ploy and it costs him eventually. Was a fine knock though but like Pujara yesterday, fails to get to the three-figure mark. Bangladesh are into the tail now. Shreyas Iyer b Ebadot Hossain 86(192) [4s-10]

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Axar, out Lbw!! Bangladesh end the day on a high! Mehidy strikes in the final over and gets rid of Axar. Was the arm-ball, pitched around off stump and skid through to beat the inside edge, striking the batter on the back pad. Looked plumb in real time itself and the ump had no hesitation in giving it. Axar tries his luck with the review after consulting Shreyas Iyer, but it's of no use. Only an inside edge could have saved him but UltraEdge shows a flat line, and ball tracking shows it to be clipping leg stump. That's the end of Axar and the day's play too. Axar lbw b Mehidy Hasan Miraz 14(26) [4s-2]

Taijul Islam to Pujara, out Bowled!! This time the bail does come off! Pujara isn't as lucky as Iyer! It's a ripper from Taijul! Gets one to spin from a middle-and-off line, was bowled flatter and Pujara played for the angle, clearly not expecting the ball to turn so much. But it does so, spinning past the blade and disturbing off stump. Was a rock-solid knock from Pujara. Apart from that dropped chance early in the morning, he played a largely chanceless knock. Unfortunate to miss the century. A timely breakthrough for Bangladesh as the big partnership was finally been broken. Can they get one more before Stumps? Pujara b Taijul Islam 90(203) [4s-11]

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Pant, out Bowled!! Mehidy with the perfect instant revenge! This is a massive breakthrough because Pant was looking in ominous touch. A loose stroke to give it away. Hangs back to a delivery that he should have been forward to, and he had also backed away a fraction to access the off-side. Gets a bottom-edge that trickles onto the stumps. Was an entertaining knock while it lasted but sadly for India, Pant isn't able to convert the start. Pant b Mehidy Hasan Miraz 46(45) [4s-6 6s-2]

Taijul Islam to Kohli, out Lbw!! That ball spun a mile and stunned Virat. Was short actually, so Virat went on the back foot to play leg-side, suddenly the ball spun sharply from the middle of the pitch and struck him on the back pad. Looked very out and umpire Michael Gough raised the finger. The only question was if it pitched in line. Pujara asked him to review with that doubt of ball maybe pitching just outside leg. Ball-tracker confirmed pitching in line with leg stump and smashed middle and leg. Bangladesh are on top now with three quick wickets. Kohli lbw b Taijul Islam 1(5)

Khaled Ahmed to Rahul, out Bowled!! The chop on! Massive wicket for Bangladesh and a livid KL Rahul punches his bat with the glove in anger as he walks off. This was a short of length delivery outside off stump, one of those rare mistakes from KL where he just hangs the bat out to guide the ball square on the off-side but it's not fully horizontal. Came down at a weird angle and he dragged it back onto the stumps. Bangladesh removed slips, bowled wicket to wicket with a tight field, built dots and have now got a biggie. It looked like a pretty easy ball to negotiate, clear error from the batter, which is why he reacted that way. Rahul b Khaled Ahmed 22(54) [4s-3]

Taijul Islam to Shubman Gill, out Caught by Yasir Ali!! Bangladesh have the breakthrough! Taijul, from wide of the crease (round the wicket), bowls an in-drifter on leg. Shubman Gill gets down to play a premeditated paddle sweep and pays the price. It was a half-hearted shot as well. The ball pops up off the top-edge. Yasir Ali smartly anticipated where the ball would go and moved towards leg slip from first slip to gobble it up. Gill will be livid with himself. Shubman Gill c Yasir Ali b Taijul Islam 20(40) [4s-3]
